Home.title: Hand-painted animal masks
Home.tagline: Every mask is one of a kind. Scarlett, an 11-year-old artist from Guatemala, paints each one to tell an animal's story.
Home.featuredEmpty: Coming soon: the first masks are being finished.
Home.meetBody: She started painting masks for fun, and now every piece has its own story. An adult in the family helps her and answers every message.
Home.step1Body: Every piece is unique: once it sells, it's gone.
Home.step2Body: Payment is processed securely at the store checkout.
Home.step3Body: We pack it with care and ship it by courier to your country.
Home.howCustom: Can't find the one you want? Order a custom mask.
